learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn interdisciplinary instruction and collaborative learning, and recognize the basic principles and application areas in sports.
Students will learn and be able to apply creative games in sports.
Students will learn and be able to apply basic football skills.
Students will know the general structure of planning, tactics, and technical applications in football.
Students will learn practical activities and training models in football.

syllabus_topics: Creative games and applications in sports
Learning basic football skills through interdisciplinary instruction and collaboration
Instruction and applications of basic football skills
Creative games and team work applications in football
